context: Tests whether the agent can run the triage-reviews skill through to execution on an approved PR: accept the real security issue and register a tracked follow-up, reject the style/nit suggestion with a reply citing the project convention, thank the praise, answer the question, resolve handled threads, and confirm idempotent-quality action reporting.

checklist.name: Report exists with decisions
checklist.description: triage-report.md exists and states for each of comments 101-104 a category and a decision (accept/reject/acknowledge) consistent with the skill's framework.

checklist.name: Accept with reaction
checklist.description: gh-record.json contains a react action with content +1 targeting comment 101 (the SQL injection finding).

checklist.name: Follow-up item registered
checklist.description: followups.json contains an item for the SQL injection fix referencing src/handler.py (line ~12) and the comment's html_url, with description and priority (critical/high).

checklist.name: Reject reply cites convention
checklist.description: gh-record.json contains a reply to comment 102 whose body cites the project's snake_case convention or ruff rule N802 (specific reason, not a generic refusal).

checklist.name: Rejection reply tone
checklist.description: The rejection reply is respectful and thanks the reviewer or offers further discussion, per the skill's tone guidance.

checklist.name: Praise acknowledged with reply
checklist.description: gh-record.json contains a reply to comment 103 (thank-you acknowledgement).

checklist.name: Question answered
checklist.description: gh-record.json contains a reply to comment 104 whose body answers from the code (the name is read from request.args) or flags uncertainty.

checklist.name: Handled threads resolved
checklist.description: gh-record.json contains resolve (minimise) actions for the rejected/praise/question threads (102, 103, 104) and does not resolve the accepted comment 101's thread.

checklist.name: No stray actions
checklist.description: No actions reference non-existent comment ids, and no duplicate react/reply/resolve for the same comment.
